Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB now supports backup and restore
items.blurb: Amazon Timestream for InfluxDB now lets you create and manage your own backups and restore your data on demand.

items.title: Amazon Cognito now available as a skill in the Agent Toolkit for AWS
items.blurb: Amazon Cognito is now available as a core skill (aws-auth) in the Agent Toolkit for AWS .

items.title: AWS IAM Identity Center supports one-click multi-Region option for new organization instances
items.blurb: AWS IAM Identity Center now makes it easier to enable multi-Region support when creating a new organization instance.

items.title: Amazon VPC IPAM now supports BGP route protection monitoring and delegated RPKI for BYOIP prefixes
items.blurb: Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) IP Address Manager (IPAM) now supports BGP route protection monitoring and delegated Resource Public Key Infrastructure (RPKI) management for Bring Your Own IP (BYOIP) prefixes.

items.title: Cloudflare Launches Persistent, Stateful, Computer-Like Environments for Agents
items.blurb: Cloudflare has introduced Cloudflare Computer, a new open-source runtime designed to give AI agents something closer to a real "computer" instead of just ephemeral containers.
